Mia Chen: Quick checkpoint — GCP + Azure marketplace listings need final assets by EOD Thursday. Do we have logo sizes and the co-brand copy?
Raj Patel: I have the logos. Waiting on legal for the co-brand line — should clear today.
Sylvia Gomez: Legal will sign off, but we need to confirm the SKU/pricing strings for each marketplace. Finance wants final SKUs before we hand to partner ops.
Mia Chen: Understood. Raj, can you drop the logos (svg + 2x png) into the shared folder? Link to folder: https://drive.redwood.ai/marketplace-assets
Raj Patel: Dropped: gcp-logo.svg, gcp-logo@2x.png, azure-logo.svg, azure-logo@2x.png. Also uploaded the draft marketplace blurb: /marketplace-blurbs/marketplace-draft-v3.md
Lewis Park: Quick note on trials — both marketplaces require a clear trial length on the listing. Legal suggested "14-day free trial with auto-conversion opt-in" copy. Is that what Product wants?
Sylvia Gomez: Product is okay with 14-day but wants opt-in checkbox on conversion. We'll need to confirm the trial SKU mapping (trial -> paid) for billing teams.
Mia Chen: Okay. Action items: Raj to confirm assets, Sylvia to confirm legal copy and trial language, Lewis to coordinate billing SKU mapping with finance. I'll own the blog + press timing.
Raj Patel: Assets confirmed. Also attached two screenshots of the console widget for the listing (console-hero-1.png, console-hero-2.png).
Jordan (partners-bot): Reminder: Marketplace checklist due in 48 hours — items open: legal signoff, SKU mapping, co-brand copy, press embargo date.
Mia Chen: Press embargo — propose Tue May 6 09:00 PT. That gives us one week for partner review and one internal day. Thoughts?
Sylvia Gomez: Works for legal side if we get partner PR clearance by Fri EOD. Need to loop in partner comms today.
Raj Patel: Partner ops needs the listing metadata (category, tags, description length). I can extract from the draft and post here by noon.
Lewis Park: Finance: I'll get SKU mapping spreadsheet to you, Mia & Raj, in 2 hours. It includes billing codes for trial->paid, and discounts for marketplace promos.
Mia Chen: Blog timing: publish the customer-facing blog simultaneously with marketplace announcement (same embargo). Draft will be ready for review Monday. I want partner quotes included — Raj, can you ask partner PM to provide one-liner by Friday?
Raj Patel: On it. Pinged Alex (partner PM) — he said yes and will send quote by Thu.
Sylvia Gomez: One more legal ask: co-brand assets require partner trademark usage approval. Please add that to partner packet.
Mia Chen: Added — partner packet updated (see link). Also we need a landing page variant for marketplace traffic with partner logos and a "Get started" CTA that links to the marketplace listing. Design to Lewis?
Lewis Park: I can spin up the landing page variant. Need hero copy and CTA URL. Raj, once listing URL is available, send it and I'll wireframe.
Jordan (partners-bot): Status update created: https://tasks.redwood.ai/board/marketplace-gTM — 7 open, 4 in review, 3 blocked (legal/trademark/sku).
Mia Chen: Final check: who will own press outreach on launch day? I can do the blog + social, but need a contact at partner comms for joint quote distribution.
Raj Patel: Alex will coordinate partner PR. I'll introduce you to Alex and cc partner comms.
Sylvia Gomez: Legal to sign off on co-brand language by Thu 5pm PT. If any delays, escalate to me.
Mia Chen: Great. I'll compile the launch timeline and publish to the team by EOD. Short next sync Friday 10am PT to confirm signoffs. :thumbsup:
Raj Patel: Thanks all — will update assets and metadata shortly.
Lewis Park: Will prepare landing page skeleton.
Jordan (partners-bot): Auto-close reminder scheduled for Fri 17:00 PT if no changes.
